behavioralDecisions.decision: Keep five ordered variants per stable card key; initial index 2. Label the control Variante, not an intensity percentage: lateral track, static looks and camera brands are categorical choices.

Incoming layer first, then active cards in source section/card order; never activation order. V6 joins intact nonempty layers with newline to fix legacy period-comma boundaries. Do not normalize user text or infer time, ratio or model settings from it.

Clear All deactivates cards and clears incoming but retains variant indices and collapsed sections, matching legacy. Defaults reset restores index 2 and collapsed sections, checkpointing setup state and keeping personal variants.

Maintain one replaceable setup-scoped incoming layer with source metadata; repeated delivery replaces it instead of concatenating. Retain legacy camera-suite target alias mapped to veo-suite. Validate message origin, source window and string payload. No inference of media references.

Keep title BZ Camera Suite, owner veo-suite and a movable placement in the camera workshop. No hardcoded Veo model, duration, aspect or resolution: this source only compiles camera/look fragments. Deck and Backstage stay fixed.

Store five variant records and stable IDs declaratively, expose edits as setup overlay, and render user labels/bodies as text. Keep compilation/state/bridge in an adapter; no evaluation or inline handlers from imported libraries.
Keep multi-card combinations even if aesthetically contradictory. No automatic exclusivity, sorting, prompt rewriting or filtering; user sees the complete compiled preview.
